selection_note: Hand-picked from the source review notes, before any pilot answers existed, to test the workflow on different kinds of reports. Not a random sample, so pilot results do not predict results for all 50 reports.

reports.why_chosen: Longest frozen report. The cause of the reaction is uncertain and allergy-test results are pending.
Has a multi-step prednisone taper, several follow-up appointments, and a cardiac finding that must not be described as negative.
Generic history and checklist sections conflict with the final assessment, and the medication list must not gain an invented course length.
One of the most consequential source conflicts: a left renal nodule in the body and a left adrenal nodule in the impression. Other findings are only possible, not certain.
Tests left and right sides and a qualified number: at least 50% narrowing, with CTA still to come.
